source: Coinbase BTC-USD / USDT-USD and Binance klines (premium and spot taker CVD); CheckOnChain etf_flows_1 Total Net Flow (Farside-derived); DefiLlama stablecoincharts/all; Binance and Coinbase order-book snapshots; Bitview seller-gauge series. Finished UTC days only. Never invented.
generated_from: last finished UTC day (buyer_lib refresh + analyze)
framing: Buyers returning, updated daily. Not a trade signal. Fully invested: no sell, exit, or trigger language.

thresholds.P: on: 30d avg premium > 0; turning: 30d <= 0 and 7d avg > 0
thresholds.E: on: ETF net flows 14d sum > 0 AND 28d sum > 0; turning: one of the two > 0
thresholds.E_5d: watch (early, not scored): 5-day calendar sum above the ETF-era median (turn line). 14d/28d still decide on/turning. A signal to watch, not a trade trigger.
thresholds.C: on: Binance spot net taker buying 14d sum > 0 (and Coinbase 14d > 0 once 14+ days logged); turning: any 7d/14d sum > 0
thresholds.S: on: total stablecoin supply 30d change >= 0; turning: 30d < 0 but 7d change >= 0
thresholds.B: live only, not scored until 30 days logged: on when Coinbase bid depth 1-5% below price, 7d avg >= 1.10 x 30d avg
thresholds.score: P+E+C+S counted as 1 each when on (turning shown, not counted). Wording is gated on P: P off -> 'Buyers still away' (or 'stirring' if P turning or 2+ others on); P on -> 'US buyers back, not broad yet'; P on and 3+ of 4 -> 'Buyers back'.

gauge_caption: The Coinbase premium is the part that matters. When the Sellers gauge hit 3 of 3 with the premium on, BTC was higher 90 days later 9 of 15 times (median +11%); with the premium off, 1 of 6 times (median -16.5%). The other parts usually turn on 2-9 weeks after a low, so they confirm a recovery rather than call it. ETF data only goes back to Jan 2024; the order book only to Nov 2026.

today.combo: Sellers still active, buyers still away

premium_on_in_dip.rule: Premium 30d avg turns positive while BTC is 20%+ below its 1-year high

score3_no_etf_in_dip.rule: Premium + Binance CVD + stablecoins all on (3 of 3, no ETF), BTC 20%+ below 1y high

score2_no_etf_in_dip.rule: 2+ of premium/CVD/stablecoins on, BTC 20%+ below 1y high

score3of4_in_dip.rule: 3+ of 4 on (ETF era, 2024+), BTC 20%+ below 1y high

seller3_and_premium_on.rule: Seller gauge 3 of 3 AND premium on

seller3_and_premium_off.rule: Seller gauge 3 of 3 while premium off or turning (2017-08+)

seller3_and_buyers2.rule: Seller gauge 3 of 3 AND 2+ of premium/CVD/stablecoins

seller3_and_premium_on.rule: Seller gauge 3 of 3 AND premium on

seller3_and_premium_off.rule: Seller gauge 3 of 3 while premium off or turning (2017-08+)

fwd_90d_in_dips.note: All days with BTC 20%+ below its 1-year high (ETF: 10%+), median 90-day return

thresholds.sample: calendar 5-day sums, ETF era from 2024-01-11, finalized days only

gaps: ETF flows: 2026-11-25 provisional (IBIT/FBTC not printed), included as provisional

notes: Score counts P, E, C, S when on (turning is shown, not counted). The order book (B) is logged from 2026-11-15 and is not scored until 30 days.
Headline wording is gated on the Coinbase premium, the only part with a measured edge. The caption is history, not a trade signal.
Values are the last finished UTC day. Refreshed by refresh_buyer_exhaustion.py. Never invented.

chart_etf_daily is daily US spot ETF net flow (Farside/CheckOnChain) and a calendar 5-day sum from Jan 2024. A provisional last day is included and flagged until IBIT and FBTC print; 14d/28d checklist sums still exclude it.
